_meta.source: Gogoi et al., J. Phys. Chem. C 2024, 128, 1654 (TFM BIB: RXN-02)
_meta.medium: EC/DEC 1:1 v/v, no LiPF6; NMR with DMSO-d6 lock; spectra recorded at RT after each hold
_meta.protocol: RT -> 80 °C in 10 °C steps, 8 h hold per step
_meta.curation: Shifts read from the paper. Barrier windows and control-experiment windows are derived from the reported observations in TFM 'KIN - DRAFT - Level 1 formulation refined scaling relations - 260928', §4.4; entries marked 'assumed' rest on a detection limit or reaction time the paper does not state.
_meta.concentrations: EC ≈ 7.1 M in EC/DEC with 5 vol% additive; 5 vol% TMSOH ≈ 0.45 M; 2 vol% TMSOH ≈ 0.18 M; 5 vol% TMSPA ≈ 0.15 M

nmr_shifts.note: approximate; TMSPA, BMSPA and MMSPA unresolved (xMSPA)

barrier_constraints.basis: No EC ring-opening by TMSOH at RT; TMS-EG clearly formed after 8 h at 80 °C (5-90 % conversion)
TMSOTMS only at impurity level from TMSOH alone after 8 h at 80 °C (< 5 % detection limit assumed)
TMSPA + TMSOH give BMSPA + TMSOTMS at RT and both vanish (≥ 95 % within 24 h assumed; time not stated)

control_experiments.label: TMSOH in EC, RT, 1 week
control_experiments.observation: No EC ring-opening at room temperature (< 2 % taken as the detection limit)

control_experiments.label: TMSOH in EC, 8 h at 80 °C
control_experiments.observation: TMS-EG clearly formed after the 80 °C hold (13C, 1H, 29Si, GC-MS); 5-90 % assumed

control_experiments.label: TMSOH in EC, 8 h at 80 °C
control_experiments.observation: TMSOTMS only at impurity level (< 5 % of the Si assumed)

control_experiments.label: TMSPA + TMSOH in EC, RT, 24 h
control_experiments.observation: TMSPA and TMSOH no longer detectable (reaction time not stated; ≤ 24 h assumed)

water_series._basis: Gogoi 2024 Fig. 1, Fig. S2 and text: 5 vol% TMSPA added to EC/DEC 1:1 pre-contaminated with H2O (stirred 24 h, rested ≥ 12 h), 31P at RT. The time between mixing and the spectrum is not stated. Windows are our reading of the qualitative description (fraction of all P); status 'reading'.

samples.observation: strong TMSPA at -24.60 ppm, weak BMSPA (Fig. 1a)
reaction stops at BMSPA while most TMSPA remains unreacted (text only)
no TMSPA; BMSPA, MMSPA and a strong H3PO4 signal (Fig. 1b)
H3PO4 and a very weak MMSPA signal (Fig. 1c)

heating.observation: the 2 vol% sample heated in the NMR tube to 80 °C: no change in the 31P signals of TMSPA, BMSPA and MMSPA apart from slight broadening (Fig. S2)
